name: Devi Temple, Pratappur
town_description: Pratappur (Pratap Pur) is a town in Surajpur district in northern Chhattisgarh, in the rice- and coal-producing Surajpur region. The district's best-known Shakti site is the Maa Bagheshwari (Kudargarhi) Devi temple at Kudargarh, about 40 km from Surajpur town.

travel.airport: Nearest airport: Ambikapur (nearest airstrip; verify) or Swami Vivekananda Airport, Raipur
travel.road: Connected by district roads from Surajpur; nearest airports cited for Surajpur ~155 km (Varanasi, per AI district report)
